[[Gahrid Dareshlar]] can found patrolling the easternmost section of the [[Citadel of Dzagon]] in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Got any candy? May a cookie or some sweet wine? I need to stay awake. I've been up forty-two hours straight. I need sugar. Barrels of sugar. I have to finish. I can't go to sleep!"''

==Quotes==
:''"Almost done. Just one more monster...."''
:''"Can't sleep. [[Kournan military|Kournans]] will eat me." 

==Trivia==
*The dialogue and quotes seems to hint at player mentality when it comes to grinding in most traditional [[W:MMORPG|MMORPGs]].
*His dialogue about sleeping may be a reference to Bart Simpson, from the [[w:The Simpsons|The Simpsons]]. <!--Bart's homemade clown bed-->
